title: Love as the Bond of the Greatness; Hatred as the First Death
description: Love is the bond of the Greatness — the cohering principle by which the Father holds the Land of Light as a single body, the Grand Man at the celestial register. The Father himself is called Agape because he gives the conjoining good to all who are in him as members. Hatred is the first death gushing from the Land of Darkness, with its descending genealogy: hatred → envy → devil → the wicked one — the inverse of Love's emanation into its members.
